action_inputs.description: CloudBolt Environment whose Azure resource handler supplies the app registration that signs the Az PowerShell session in; only Azure-backed environments the ordering group may use are listed.
action_inputs.label: Environment
action_inputs.name: env_id

action_inputs.description: Which Remote Script to run: one of the disabled Remote Script build items on this blueprint, listed by item name; it runs under PowerShell 7 in Azure's deployment-script container.
action_inputs.label: Script
action_inputs.name: script

action_inputs.description: JSON object of the chosen script's action-input values keyed by input name, e.g. {"name_filter": "rg-prod-*"}; inputs left out fall back to the build item's pinned defaults.
action_inputs.label: Script Parameters (JSON)
action_inputs.name: script_parameters

description: Signs an Az PowerShell session in with the selected environment's Azure app registration via a short-lived access token and runs one of the blueprint's disabled Remote Scripts in a Microsoft-managed container through an ARM deployment script hosted by the blueprint's pinned execution environment, with no Run on Server host.
name: Run Azure PowerShell Script (Deployment Script)
